caseNameFull: David Atkins v. State of Ohio
attorneys: Mr. E. L. Mills, with whom Messrs. Smith W. Bennett and T. J. Denkenherd were on the brief, for plaintiff in error., Messrs. Edward C. Turner, Henry W. Harter, Jr., and C. B. McClintock were on the brief for the State of Ohio.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Writ of. error dismissed under § 237 of the Judicial Code as amended by the Act of Feburary 13, 1925, 43 Stat. 936, and, treating the writ of error as an application for a writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Messrs. Edward C. Turner, Henry W. Harter, Jr., and C. B. McClintock were on the brief for the State of Ohio.
